```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, "TransferSemi", "DESCRIPTION")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(current, "visualization_github"))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Cannot locate the repository root.", call. = FALSE)
}
repo_root <- find_repo_root()
source(file.path(repo_root, "visualization_github", "visualization_config.R"))
config <- visualization_config(repo_root, "read_real_analysis")
derived_dir <- config$derived_dir
figure_dir <- config$figure_dir
resolve_repo_path <- function(value, default) {
  if (!nzchar(value)) return(default)
  expanded <- path.expand(value)
  is_absolute <- grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|\\\\\\\\)", expanded)
  if (is_absolute) expanded else file.path(repo_root, expanded)
}
data_folder_path <- resolve_repo_path(
  Sys.getenv("TRANSFERSEMI_REAL_OUTPUT_DIR", unset = ""),
  file.path(repo_root, "real_data", "result_real_data")
)
corr_dir <- resolve_repo_path(
  Sys.getenv("TRANSFERSEMI_CORR_OUTPUT_DIR", unset = ""),
  file.path(repo_root, "real_data", "corr")
)

dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

mean_summary_file <- file.path(derived_dir, "Mean_Mean_model_summaries.RData")
maximum_summary_file <- file.path(derived_dir, "Mean_maximum_MSE.RData")

safe_pairwise_cor <- function(x, y) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  y <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  min_len <- min(length(x), length(y))
  if (min_len <= 1L) return(NA_real_)
  x <- x[seq_len(min_len)]
  y <- y[seq_len(min_len)]
  complete <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  if (sum(complete) <= 1L) return(NA_real_)
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(stats::sd(x[complete]), 0)) ||
      isTRUE(all.equal(stats::sd(y[complete]), 0))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  suppressWarnings(stats::cor(x[complete], y[complete], method = "pearson"))
}
```

```{r}
format_list_to_df <- function(eval_list) {
  # Initialize an empty data frame
  result_df <- data.frame(
    Model = character(),
    Subgroup = integer(),
    MSE = numeric(),
    Value_Function = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  model_names <- head(names(eval_list), 9)
  for (model_name in model_names) {
    model_result <- eval_list[[model_name]]
    n_subgroups <- if (model_name == "eval_pool") 1L else length(model_result)
    for (i in seq_len(n_subgroups)) {
      if (model_name == "eval_pool") {
        mse_list <- model_result$mse
        value_list <- model_result$value_function
      } else {
        mse_list <- model_result[[i]]$mse
        value_list <- model_result[[i]]$value_function
      }
     
      for (j in seq_along(mse_list)) {
        mse_value <- mse_list[[j]][[1]]
        value_function_value <- value_list[[j]][[1]]
        
        result_df <- rbind(result_df, data.frame(
          Model = model_name,
          Subgroup = i,
          MSE = mse_value,
          Value_Function = value_function_value
        ))
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(result_df)
}
```

```{r}
models <- unique(final_df$Model)

p_value_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(models), ncol = length(models), 
                         dimnames = list(models, models))
mean_value_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = length(models), ncol = length(models), 
                         dimnames = list(models, models))

for (i in 1:(length(models) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(models)) {
    model1 <- models[i]
    model2 <- models[j]
    
    data1 <- final_df$MSE[final_df$Model == model1]
    data2 <- final_df$MSE[final_df$Model == model2]
    mean1 <- mean(data1)
    mean2 <- mean(data2)
    
    ttest_result <- t.test(data1, data2)
    
    p_value_matrix[model1, model2] <- ttest_result$p.value
    p_value_matrix[model2, model1] <- ttest_result$p.value # Symmetric
    diff1 <- mean1 - mean2
    diff2 <- mean2 - mean1
    value1 <- if (ttest_result$p.value < 0.05) paste0(round(diff1, 3), "**") else round(diff1, 3)
    value2 <- if (ttest_result$p.value < 0.05) paste0(round(diff2, 3), "**") else round(diff2, 3)
    
    # Store the strings
    mean_value_matrix[model1, model2] <- value1
    mean_value_matrix[model2, model1] <- value2
  }
}

print(as.data.frame(p_value_matrix))
print(as.data.frame(mean_value_matrix))
```

```{r}
all_dfs <- list()

models <- c("para_transfer_tuned", "no_transfer", "semipara_transfer_tuned", "Sai_transfer", "ARMUL", "pERM")

for (model in models){
for (index in 1:4) {
  file_name <- paste0("eval_", model, "_w_race.Rdata")
  a <- readRDS(file.path(corr_dir, file_name))
  if(model == "Sai_transfer"){target = a[[index]]$f_hat}else{
  target <- (a[[index]]$f_hat[[1]][[1]] + a[[index]]$f_hat[[2]][[1]])/2}
  continuous_vars <- c("ben1tot", "se1tot", "sus1tot", "fear1tot", "fatal1tot", "know1tot")
  selected_columns <- X[[index]]#[, continuous_vars, drop = FALSE]
  
  correlations <- vapply(
    seq_len(ncol(selected_columns)),
    function(i) safe_pairwise_cor(selected_columns[, i], target),
    numeric(1)
  )
  names(correlations) <- colnames(selected_columns)
  
  n_task <- index
  
  
  # Create a data frame
  final_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = names(correlations),
    Correlation = correlations,
    n_task = n_task,
    model = model,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE # Ensures string variables remain as character type
  )
  
  all_dfs[[model]][[index]] <- final_df
}
}
model = "pool"
file_name <- paste0("eval_", model, "_w_race.Rdata")
b <- readRDS(file.path(corr_dir, file_name))
pool_target <- (b$f_hat[[1]][[1]] + b$f_hat[[2]][[1]]) / 2
X_pool <- readRDS(file.path(corr_dir, "pool_X.Rdata"))
selected_columns <- X_pool
  
correlations <- vapply(
  seq_len(ncol(selected_columns)),
  function(i) safe_pairwise_cor(selected_columns[, i], pool_target),
  numeric(1)
)
names(correlations) <- colnames(selected_columns)

n_task <- 0L
final_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(correlations),
  Correlation = correlations,
  n_task = n_task,
  model = model,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE # Ensures string variables remain as character type
)
all_dfs[[model]][[1]] <- final_df
all_dfs_flattened <- do.call(c, all_dfs)
combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all_dfs_flattened)
print(combined_df)
```

```{r}
  filter(Var1 == "Late Fusion with Nuisance") %>%
  arrange(desc(value)) %>%
  pull(Var2) |> unique()

# Reorder data based on the rank order
heatmap_data2$Var2 <- factor(heatmap_data2$Var2, levels = rank_order)
heatmap_data2$Var1 <- factor(heatmap_data2$Var1, levels = rev(levels(heatmap_data2$Var1)))
method_order <- c(
  "Baseline",
  "Data Pooling",
  "Oracle Trans-Lasso",
  "Representation Transfer",
  "pERM",
  "ARMUL",
  "Late Fusion",
  "Late Fusion with Nuisance"
)

heatmap_data2$Var1 <- factor(heatmap_data2$Var1, levels = rev(method_order))
p<-ggplot(heatmap_data2, aes(Var2, Var1, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  #geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 3)), color = "black", size=2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size=13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )+
  labs(x = "Variable", y = NULL, fill = "Correlation")
p
ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, "corr.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 6)
```

```{r}
df =rbind(miximum_MSE, mean_sd_by_model)
df <- df[!(df$Model %in% c("eval_para_transfer_untuned_max", "eval_semipara_transfer_untuned_max", "eval_para_transfer_untuned_mean", "eval_semipara_transfer_untuned_mean")), ]

df$Group <- ifelse(grepl("_max$", df$Model), "Max", "Mean")

df$Model <- gsub("eval_|_max|_mean", "", df$Model)
df$Model <- gsub("_", " ", df$Model)
df$Model <- gsub("no transfer", "Baseline", df$Model)
df$Model <- gsub("para transfer tuned", "Late Fusion", df$Model)
df$Model <- gsub("semiLate Fusion", "Late Fusion with Nuisance", df$Model)
df$Method = df$Model
custom_colors <- c("Baseline" = "orange", 
                   "Late Fusion" = "red", 
                   "Late Fusion with Nuisance" = "darkgreen")

p=ggplot(df, aes(x = Method, y = MSE.mean, color = Method)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MSE.mean - 1.96 *MSE.sd/10, ymax = MSE.mean + 1.96 *MSE.sd/10),
                width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Group, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(
       x = "Method",
       y = "MSE Mean",
       color = "Method") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
